model.name: R19.94: App header shows version string on all screens — small, undisturbing.
model.description: The app HEADER MUST display the current version (e.g. 'v0.5.x · rawbin') on ALL screens. The version text is small and undisturbing (low contrast, small font) so it doesn't dominate the UI but is always visible — especially useful on screenshots for bug reports and QA.
model.tronQuote: > TRON: "add version to the header small undisturbing so you see it on all screenshots"
